_comment: Approved HIGH-severity vulnerability exceptions. A HIGH finding with a valid (non-expired) entry naming its exact CVE+package reports WARN instead of FAIL -- matching is per-CVE-per-package, not 'any entry exists' (that was a real bug in tests/security/runner.js, fixed 2026-08-21). CRITICAL findings can never be excepted here, by design and by explicit policy: tests/security/runner.js's isExcepted() hard-rejects severity!=='HIGH' before ever checking this file, and gate.js treats any blocking CRITICAL FAIL as an automatic NO-GO regardless of this file's content. Expiry is checked programmatically against the run date; an expired entry reports FAIL, no manual override. First real triage (2026-08-21, docs/evidence/CVE_TRIAGE.md) found strong non-exploitability evidence for several CRITICAL findings (unused CLI tools, a disabled feature flag, a 32-bit-only advisory on a 64-bit deployment) -- none of that evidence is recorded as an exception here, because none of it is eligible: it's CRITICAL-severity, full stop. That evidence stays in the triage report as risk-prioritization context, not as a gate override.
